text:
incident-bot: HIGH_SEVERITY: GPU provision queue on prod-cluster has been growing for 12m. autoscaler observed 480 pending pods needing nvidia-gpu label. avg pod wait 45s -> throughput degradation. paging oncall @alice_oncall :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: on it — joining bridge now. can someone paste a rough impact summary?

luca_cs: customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants seeing degraded inference throughput, tail latency up 3x, some requests hitting 30s timeouts. first reports ~ 10:08 PT.

raj_sre: looking at autoscaler logs — seeing repeated register timeouts from kubelet: `kubelet register: timeout waiting for node status`. autoscaler attempted scale-up -> rejected due to nodegroup filter mismatch: "no matching NodeGroup for labels".

emma_runtime: checking cluster state: ASGs show 0 pending instances; launch-configs for gpu-pool-v2 were recently rotated 2h ago. there are a bunch of nodes in NotReady with taint gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule.

alice_oncall: @raj_sre steps? can we trigger manual scale?

raj_sre: trying manual increase of desired count on ASG gpu-pool-v2 to +4. if ASG spins up but nodes fail to join, we need to debug instance bootstrap/iam attach. running: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-v2 --desired-capacity 8`

deploy-bot: Deploy event: kubelet boot script output indicates `failed to attach iam instance profile` on 2 instances (i-0a12345, i-0b67890). last bootstrap log lines:

```

2026-03-15T17:12:03Z kubelet: registering node
2026-03-15T17:12:10Z bootstrap: attach-role failed: InstanceProfileNotFound: InstanceProfile gpu-node-role-v2 not found

```

raj_sre: that explains register timeout. ASG brings instances up but they never finish bootstrapping so autoscaler sees no capacity.

emma_runtime: looks like the new launch-config references gpu-node-role-v2 which was rolled out but not created in the account because of a terraform race in the infra pipeline. open issue on infra repo says role creation pending.

alice_oncall: OK immediate mitigations: 1) roll back ASG to old launch-config that used gpu-node-role-v1 2) increase fallback capacity in hosted region to re-route non-critical jobs 3) notify affected customers about degraded throughput. I will start rollback now.

raj_sre: rolling launch-config back: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-v2 --launch-configuration-name gpu-lc-v1`

emma_runtime: rolling back triggers new instances with the old instance profile. starting to watch node join events.

alice_oncall: customer comms: @luca_cs can you draft a short note? include ETA for mitigation and mention we're switching to fallback capacity while we fix infra role.

luca_cs: on it. draft: "We're investigating capacity issues causing increased latency for GPU inference. We're performing a rollback to restore node bootstrapping; expected mitigation within 20-30 minutes. We'll update in-channel and follow up with a post-incident summary."

raj_sre: nodes coming up — 3 nodes in Ready state now. autoscaler sees new capacity, queue length dropping. I see older pending pods being scheduled.

alice_oncall: monitoring: pending pods decreased from 480 -> 40 in 11m. 95th percentile latency for affected tenants reduced from 12s -> 4s. good.

emma_runtime: leaving a note: we should mark the infra pipeline as failed and block future LC rotations until role creation is confirmed. opened infra ticket: INFRA-4821.

alice_oncall: moving to mitigation->postmortem. handoff to @raj_sre for investigation and to @sara_prod for customer follow-up. I'll keep incident channel open for 30m then archive.

sara_prod: contacting top impacted accounts with ETA and temporary credits offer. will sync with CS for followup.

raj_sre: initial followup plan: 1) collect bootstrap logs for all failed instances 2) confirm terraform race and sequence causing missing InstanceProfile 3) write a gating check in CI to verify IAM resources exist before launch-config rotates 4) add autoscaler fallback policy to prefer existing launch-configs if new ones report node bootstrap failure for >5m.

alice_oncall: any residual risk?

emma_runtime: risk: future LC rotations could slip again; mitigation: CI gate + short-circuit in autoscaler that tolerates transient missing nodes by trying older LCs automatically.

raj_sre: tagging incident severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 as customer impact limited and rollback successful.

incident-bot: Incident update: Status=Mitigated, Mitigation=rollback to gpu-lc-v1 and manual ASG bump, Next action=postmortem + infra pipeline fix.

alice_oncall: thanks team. please add any logs/commands to the postmortem doc. closing bridge in 30. :thumbsup:

luca_cs: shared customer note sent to 3 tenants; will post copy to incident doc.

raj_sre: saved autoscaler logs snapshot /artifacts/autoscaler-8101239876.tar.gz and attached to INFRA-4821.

alice_oncall: closing thread in 30m unless someone needs more time. great work. :heart:
